cues: Heat to ninety five degrees: the strands separate.
Cool to about fifty five: the primers stick.
Warm to seventy two: Taq builds new strands from the primers.
And every cycle doubles the number of copies.
text: Each cycle has three steps. Heat to ninety five degrees: the strands separate. Cool to about fifty five: the primers stick. Warm to seventy two: Taq builds new strands from the primers. And every cycle doubles the number of copies.
